name: Ansal Housing Limited
about: Ansal Housing Limited, together with its subsidiaries, develops and sells residential real estate properties in India. The company develops plotted developments, houses, villas, and apartments; integrated townships; high-end and luxury residential projects; and commercial and shopping complexes. It is also involved in the promotion, construction, and development of multi-storeyed buildings, flats, and shopping malls, etc. The company was formerly known as Ansal Housing & Construction Limited and changed its name to Ansal Housing Limited in December 2018. Ansal Housing Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Ghaziabad, India.
